items.titleZh: 一宗罪 · 歧：同是 MIT 开源，两副嘴脸
items.noteEn: Threatened to get a Chinese dev's GitHub banned 11 minutes after a free MIT fork, then said 11 hours later that trillion-dollar US labs are welcome to copy MIT code.
items.noteZh: 中国开发者做了免费 MIT Fork，他 11 分钟内威胁找 GitHub 封号；11 小时后聊到万亿美元美国大厂抄开源代码，他却说开源本来就能随便用。

items.titleZh: 二宗罪 · 欺：嘴上说不追踪，代码默认全开
items.noteEn: The homepage promised 'No telemetry. Unless you opt in. Full stop.' while the app turned PostHog on by default and hashed other tools' login files.
items.noteZh: 官网首页写着绝不追踪，实际软件默认打开 PostHog 上报，还把 ~/.claude.json 等别家工具的登录文件拿去做哈希。

items.titleZh: 三宗罪 · 吞：41.6 GB 假删除 + 5 秒扫全机
items.noteEn: Clicking 'permanently delete' kept full chats on disk (bloating one database to 41.6 GB), while a background task scanned every running program every 5 seconds.
items.noteZh: 点永久删除并没有真删，聊天记录全留在本地数据库里一路胀到 41.6 GB；后台还每 5 秒扫一遍全电脑正在跑的程序。

items.titleZh: 四宗罪 · 怠：致命 Bug 躺 52 天，删隐私过滤只用 21 小时
items.noteEn: Left a bug that silently ran git push --force open for 52+ days, yet needed only 21 hours to drop a privacy filter so private models showed up on his leaderboard.
items.noteZh: 会自动静默执行 git push --force 的高危 Bug 放了 52 天没修，但为了给自家榜单导数据，删掉隐私过滤只花了 21 小时。

items.titleZh: 五宗罪 · 伪：伪造内部请求头，新号 3 分钟被封
items.noteEn: The FAQ promised zero ban risk, while the code faked internal Google headers and SSH variables, getting a brand-new $20 account banned in 3 minutes.
items.noteZh: 官方 FAQ 保证零封号风险，代码却提取系统密钥伪造 Google 内部请求头去连接口，刚花 20 美元开的新号 3 分钟就被封了。

items.titleZh: 六宗罪 · 裸：远程终端中继没有端到端加密
items.noteEn: T3 Connect terminates TLS on their own server with no end-to-end encryption, meaning your terminal traffic passes through their relay in plaintext.
items.noteZh: T3 Connect 远程连接没有端到端加密，用户的终端命令和输出都会以明文经过官方中继服务器。

items.titleZh: 七宗罪 · 妒：投了别人又嘲讽、还亲自下场抢生意
items.noteEn: After angel-investing in Vibe Kanban and Daytona, Theo publicly mocked Vibe Kanban shutting down and pitched paid cloud sandboxes directly competing with Daytona.
items.noteZh: 他投了 Vibe Kanban 和 Daytona，结果公开嘲讽 Vibe Kanban 倒闭，又在 T3 Code 里提议做付费云沙盒跟 Daytona 正面抢生意。

items.titleZh: 八宗罪 · 盲：自夸企业策略全关闭，文档自己打脸
items.noteEn: Claimed corporate Managed Policy makes it trivial to shut off all telemetry, while T3 Code's own docs listed four places where data still gets sent.
items.noteZh: 他吹嘘自家企业托管策略能一键关掉所有追踪，结果自家官方文档白纸黑字写着还有 4 个关不掉的盲区。

items.titleZh: 九宗罪 · 贪：拿默认遥测当免费商业情报雷达
items.noteEn: Default-on tracking fed a live radar watching 31.7 trillion tokens a day across users, used to pitch investors and land $300k+ in free API credits.
items.noteZh: 免费客户端默认收集的数据汇总成每天 31.7 万亿 Token 的实时监控大盘，用来谈投资和拿超过 30 万美元的免费额度。

items.titleZh: 十宗罪 · 狂：自己随便合并，却骂提建议的用户
items.noteEn: Bragged about 500 commits a day and 'yolo merges,' then called a user giving feedback on GitHub Issue #33639 an 'ungrateful prick who is lazy as shit.'
items.noteZh: 平时吹嘘自己日均 500 提交、靠 yolo merges 硬合代码，转头在 GitHub Issue 里把提反馈的用户骂成「忘恩负义的懒鬼混蛋」。

items.titleZh: 十一宗罪 · 窃：喊完「我要偷了」，30 秒派机器人扒代码
items.noteEn: Replied 'Okay I'm stealing this' to another developer's fork and 30 seconds later told @bot to go copy her code into T3 Code.
items.noteZh: 看到女开发者做的好功能，他公然回复「我要偷这个了」，30 秒后就直接让 @bot 去扒对方 Fork 的源码抄进自家项目。

items.titleZh: 十二宗罪 · 谎：上午发澄清，2 小时内被自家补丁打脸
items.noteEn: Claimed in the morning they never logged file paths and opt-outs always worked; within two hours, his own team's emergency GDPR patches proved the opposite.
items.noteZh: 早上刚发帖保证从没收集过文件路径、退出开关一直有效，不到两小时自家团队连夜合的紧急补丁就把这几条全证伪了。

items.titleZh: 十三宗罪 · 瞒：悄悄修漏洞，安全公告挂零
items.noteEn: Quietly patched serious security holes inside regular pull requests without ever publishing a single GitHub Security Advisory to warn users.
items.noteZh: 高危安全漏洞都混在普通 PR 里悄悄修掉，从未在 GitHub 上发过哪怕 1 份正式安全公告提醒用户升级。

items.titleZh: 十四宗罪 · 谄：见大厂高管 0 脏话，见普通开发者张口就骂
items.noteEn: Across 1,151 consecutive posts: 0% swearing at 20 Big-Tech executives, 8% at regular developers, spiking 4x to 14.4% during the Chinese-fork meltdown.
items.noteZh: 统计连续 1,151 条推文：对 20 位大厂高管脏话率 0%，对普通开发者 8%，在中文 Fork 冲突那 25 小时里直接飙到 14.4%。

items.titleZh: 十五宗罪 · 诈：手里 0 件商标，威胁完封号才连夜补规矩
items.noteEn: Threatened a GitHub ban over 'trademark infringement' while holding zero US registered trademarks, then merged a TRADEMARK.md policy 17 hours later.
items.noteZh: 拿「商标侵权」威胁找 GitHub 封别人号时，他公司在美国商标局连 1 件注册商标都没有，17 小时后才仓促补了一份 TRADEMARK.md。

items.titleZh: 十六宗罪 · 惯：2024 到 2026，同一套戏码演了三年
items.noteEn: 2024 harassment wave against Indian dev channels, 2025 $20k FFmpeg bounty stunt, 2026 Chinese tech Twitter tirade: the same cycle every year.
items.noteZh: 2024 年挂印度开发者、2025 年拿 2 万美元悬赏挤兑 FFmpeg 维护者、2026 年骂中文科技圈是粪坑，连续三年同一套操作。

items.titleZh: 十七宗罪 · 矫：嘴上讲合规，背地分享多号白嫖代理
items.noteEn: Lectured others about rules and ToS while sharing a 10-account proxy Gist to bypass API limits and embedding his YouTube sponsors inside the cloud relay.
items.noteZh: 嘴上大谈合规与版权，背地却分享过用 10 个账号搭代理池绕过额度限制的脚本，还把 YouTube 赞助商直接嵌进云中继。

items.titleZh: 十八宗罪 · 虚：骂完假星骗融资，自己弹窗冲到 7.7 万星
items.noteEn: Mocked GitHub stars as a trick to fool VCs in April, then merged a 30-second idle popup using local credentials that pumped stars from 30k to 77k.
items.noteZh: 4 月还骂 GitHub Star 是用来骗投资人的，11 月就自己合了 30 秒闲置弹窗，靠用户本地登录凭证把星数从 3 万刷到 7.7 万。

items.titleZh: 十九宗罪 · 漏：最新版本仍留着 5 个安全漏洞
items.noteEn: Even after 259 more commits, five security holes remained open: plaintext 30-day LAN cookies, non-revocable Bearer tokens, and exposed SSH agents.
items.noteZh: 即便连夜补了几百个提交，最新代码里依然留着 30 天明文局域网 Cookie、没法吊销的 Token 和陌生仓库暴露 SSH 密钥等 5 个漏洞。

items.titleZh: 二十宗罪 · 胁：89 次浏览的推文引来深夜威胁与 AWS HR 投诉
items.noteEn: After AWS engineer @dmfigol posted an 89-view, 0-like critique, Theo entered midnight DMs declaring 'Fear is a good incentive,' mocked his English, and complained to AWS HR.
items.noteZh: AWS 工程师 @dmfigol 发了一条只有 89 次浏览、0 点赞的吐槽，Theo 深夜杀进私信扬言「恐惧是很好的激励」，羞辱对方英语非母语，逼对方道歉后还捅到 AWS HR。

items.titleZh: 二十一宗罪 · 冒：冒充白名单编辑器 Zed，被 Google 警告后藏进更新日志
items.noteEn: PR #43026 and #43087 admitted Google warned internal API calls can flag accounts and T3 spoofed clientInfo: { name: 'zed' }. v0.1.13 hid both fixes inside '+380 bug fixes.'
items.noteZh: 官方 PR #43026 和 #43087 亲口承认 Google 警告调用内部接口会封号，且 T3 握手时冒充过白名单编辑器 Zed；v0.1.13 发布说明却把这两项藏进了「其余 380 项修复」里。

items.titleZh: 二十二宗罪 · 遁：刚发最终声明 16 分钟被打脸，干脆把追踪藏进闭源后端
items.noteEn: 16 minutes after Theo's 'Final statement,' @sk1gl4a caught T3 reading 243 local Claude chats and billing 19% German VAT. Maintainers then closed PR #43889: 'nvm easier to do in slophouse.'
items.noteZh: 刚发完九连绝不最终声明 16 分钟，就被德国开发者抓包偷偷扫描了 243 个本机 Claude 会话；维护者随后关闭追踪 PR，只留一句「算了，直接在闭源 slophouse 后端做更省事」。

items.titleZh: 二十三宗罪 · 破：静音 Anthropic 安全警告，把 11 个浏览器的登录态全塞给桌面端 Agent
items.noteEn: Monkey-patched process.emitWarning to silence Anthropic's approval-shadowing warning, let host uploadFiles bypass Codex's sandbox, and left 11 browsers' cookies unisolated on Desktop.
items.noteZh: 硬写钩子静音 Anthropic 的权限绕过警告，内置浏览器允许不经终端上传任意绝对路径文件绕开 Codex 沙盒，还把 11 个浏览器的解密 Cookie 塞进了桌面端未隔离的共享配置里。

items.titleZh: 二十四宗罪 · 泄：把私密正文和完整 Prompt 塞进明文 URL，4 分 39 秒锁单冷处理
items.noteEn: Packed 8,000-char quotes, 32-char unselected context, and full prompts into plaintext URLs. When reported in Issue #29449, Julius locked it in 4m 39s with 0 replies and deleted the doc.
items.noteZh: 复制引用和分享 Prompt 链接会把最多 8,000 字私密对话、前后各 32 字未选中上下文和完整提示词直接塞进明文 URL；隐私 Bug #29449 仅 4 分 39 秒就被零回复锁单转走，还删掉了说明文档。

items.titleZh: Drake 拒绝/点赞：11 小时两种态度
items.noteEn: China dev makes a free MIT fork? Threaten a GitHub ban. Trillion-dollar US lab copies MIT code 11 hours later? 'Open source is open source!'
items.noteZh: 中国开发者免费 Fork MIT 代码：立刻改名不然封号；11 小时后换成万亿美元美国大厂来抄：开源就是开源，随便用！

items.titleEn: Yelling at a Legal MIT Fork
items.titleZh: 对着合法开源 Fork 破防大喊「Temu3 Code」
items.noteEn: Screaming 'Chinese knockoff' and 'Temu3 Code' at a developer who simply forked an MIT-licensed repo like the license explicitly allows.
items.noteZh: 对方只是按 MIT 开源协议做了个免费 Fork，完全合法，他却冲上去大骂「山寨货」「Temu3 Code」还威胁封号。

items.titleZh: 撕开「绝不追踪」的面具
items.noteEn: What was actually hiding behind the homepage promise 'No telemetry. Full stop.': default-on PostHog tracking and hashing ~/.claude.json.
items.noteZh: 官网首页写着绝不追踪，打开源码一掀面具：默认开启 PostHog 上报，顺手还把别的 AI 工具的登录凭证拿去做哈希。

items.titleZh: 宇宙脑：面对用户要求关闭追踪的四步操作
items.noteEn: First promise no tracking, then quietly delete the promise, then reject 4 community opt-out PRs, and still ship zero Settings switches.
items.noteZh: 第一步写绝不追踪，第二步悄悄删掉承诺，第三步连拒 4 个社区提交的关闭开关 PR，第四步设置页至今还是 0 个开关。

items.titleEn: Flex Tape on the 41.6 GB Fake Delete
items.titleZh: 强力胶硬贴 41.6 GB 假删除
items.noteEn: Clicking 'permanently delete' only hid threads in the UI while leaving everything inside statev2.sqlite, bloating one user's disk by 41.6 GB.
items.noteZh: 点了永久删除其实只做了界面隐藏，聊天数据原封不动留在硬盘里，有用户本地库一路胀到 41.6 GB。

items.titleEn: Wait, It Scans All OS Processes Every 5s?
items.titleZh: 等等，它每 5 秒扫一次全机进程？一直都是
items.noteEn: A background Rust monitor quietly enumerated every running process and full command line on your machine every 5 seconds with no way to turn it off.
items.noteZh: 后台有个 Rust 任务，每 5 秒扫描一遍你整台电脑上所有正在运行的程序和完整命令行，而且没有关闭入口。

items.titleEn: Asleep for 52 Days, Awake in 21 Hours
items.titleZh: 致命 Bug 睡 52 天，删隐私过滤 21 小时秒醒
items.noteEn: Ignored a bug silently running git push --force for 52+ days, but woke up fast to remove a model privacy filter in 21 hours for his public leaderboard.
items.noteZh: 会偷偷强推代码覆盖主分支的 Bug 躺了 52 天没人理，一听说要给自家公开榜单导数据，21 小时就把隐私白名单删干净了。

items.titleZh: 回头哥：抛弃隐私保护，盯上自家榜单
items.noteEn: Chose feeding private model usage into slopalytics.com over keeping users' model privacy whitelist intact.
items.noteZh: 为了让自己做的 slopalytics 榜单数据更好看，直接把原本保护用户隐私的模型过滤白名单给拆了。

items.titleZh: Antigravity 魔改交易：你交账号，我送封号
items.noteEn: You hand over your Google account; T3 Code spoofs internal Google headers and gets you banned in 3 minutes.
items.noteZh: 代码提取你的钥匙串凭证并伪造 Google 内部请求头，用户交出刚充钱的账号，换来 3 分钟极速封号。

items.titleZh: 伪造内部接口被秒封后的震惊皮卡丘
items.noteEn: Spoofed Google's private v1internal endpoint and fake SSH headers, then acted shocked when fresh accounts got banned immediately.
items.noteZh: 拿着伪造的内部请求头硬打 Google 私有接口，结果新号 3 分钟就被风控封禁，还一副很意外的样子。

items.titleEn: Best I Can Do Is Plaintext Relay
items.titleZh: 典当行：想要端到端加密？最多给明文中继
items.noteEn: Users expected encrypted remote sessions in T3 Connect; the relay actually terminates TLS on their own servers with zero end-to-end encryption.
items.noteZh: 大家以为远程连终端是端到端加密的，查完源码发现流量在官方中继服务器上直接解密明文转发。

items.titleEn: Angel Investor Laughing at a Shutdown
items.titleZh: 天使投资人举杯嘲讽被投项目停服
items.noteEn: After investing in Vibe Kanban and Daytona, Theo publicly mocked Vibe Kanban shutting down while pitching a competing paid sandbox inside T3 Code.
items.noteZh: 自己当了天使投资人，结果公开拿被投产品 Vibe Kanban 倒闭找乐子，转头还要在自家软件里做同类付费云沙盒。

items.titleEn: Two Buttons: Marketing vs. Own Docs
items.titleZh: 流汗选按钮：嘴上吹牛 vs 自家文档打脸
items.noteEn: Sweating between bragging 'best managed policy turns off all telemetry' and T3 Code's own docs admitting 4 blind spots still send data.
items.noteZh: 一边在推上吹自家企业策略能彻底关掉所有上报，另一边自家文档自己承认还有 4 个关不掉的角落。

items.titleEn: Once Again Asking for Your 31.7T Tokens
items.titleZh: 桑德斯：再次向你索要免费算力数据
items.noteEn: Users' default-on telemetry fed a 31.7 trillion tokens/day radar that Theo used to show off market intelligence to investors and AI labs.
items.noteZh: 大家平时用客户端默认上报的数据，汇成了每天 31.7 万亿 Token 的算力雷达，成了他跟大厂和投资人谈资源的筹码。

items.titleEn: Default Telemetry Was the Business Model
items.titleZh: 摆摊辩论：默认遥测不是手滑，就是生意
items.noteEn: Turning tracking on by default, rejecting 4 opt-out PRs, and piping 31.7T tokens/day into a live dashboard wasn't an accident.
items.noteZh: 默认开启追踪、连拒 4 个关闭开关 PR、把数据接进实时大盘，这一连串操作显然不是不小心写错一行代码。

items.titleZh: 会议室扔出窗外：居然敢提加关闭开关？
items.noteEn: When contributors submitted tested PRs to add a simple telemetry toggle in Settings, the maintainers rejected them and said they wouldn't make opting out easier.
items.noteZh: 社区开发者把带 147 项测试的遥测开关 PR 都写好了，维护者直接拒绝，还明说「不会让退出变得更容易」。

items.titleZh: 还有没有社区 Fork？30 秒给你扒走
items.noteEn: After replying 'Okay I'm stealing this' to a dev's fork, he immediately dispatched @bot to scrape her repo and port the feature.
items.noteZh: 看到别人 Fork 做出的好功能，喊完一句「我要偷这个了」，立刻叫机器人去把对方仓库扒过来照搬。

items.titleEn: Hard Swerve: Scrape Her Fork in 30s
items.titleZh: 高速急拐：自己偷别人 Fork 只用 30 秒
items.noteEn: Threatened legal action over someone forking his repo, yet swerved straight into sending @bot to scrape another developer's fork 30 seconds after seeing it.
items.noteZh: 别人 Fork 他项目就要找 GitHub 封号，自己看到别人 Fork 里的好点子，30 秒就派机器人直接扒走。

items.titleEn: Morning Clarification Hit by Own PRs
items.titleZh: 早上刚发澄清，两小时被自家 PR 撞飞
items.noteEn: Theo posted a morning thread insisting no paths were logged and opt-outs worked; two hours later, his team's own emergency PRs admitted the exact bugs.
items.noteZh: 上午刚发长文拍胸脯保证没收路径、开关都好使，不到两小时自家团队连夜合的补丁就把这些话全撞碎了。

items.titleZh: 火海里喝咖啡：每小时 220 万条 IP 日志
items.noteEn: Overnight patches after an EU GDPR complaint accidentally exposed that the relay was logging 2.2M IP-tagged requests per hour in Axiom for 30 days.
items.noteZh: 欧盟 GDPR 举报后连夜补锅，意外曝光中继每小时往 Axiom 写 220 万条带真实 IP 的日志，一留就是 30 天。

items.titleZh: 欧盟 GDPR 举报后的连夜惊慌三连
items.noteEn: Got reported for GDPR, rushed 6 hours of overnight patches to calm things down, only for the patches themselves to expose even bigger leaks.
items.noteZh: 收到欧盟隐私举报一阵慌乱，连夜狂打 6 小时补丁以为稳了，结果大家一看补丁源码，发现里面藏着更大的泄露。

items.titleZh: 强颜欢笑：漏洞悄悄修了一堆，安全公告还是 0
items.noteEn: Serious vulnerabilities were patched quietly in routine commits, leaving the GitHub Security Advisories tab completely empty at 0.
items.noteZh: 好几个高危漏洞都藏在日常提交里悄悄改掉了，GitHub 安全公告栏至今干干净净挂着个 0。

items.titleEn: Gordon Ramsay: VIPs vs. Chinese Devs
items.titleZh: 地狱厨房双标：对硅谷大佬温柔，对中文圈狂喷
items.noteEn: Data from 1,151 posts: polite and zero swearing toward 20 Big-Tech VIPs, while calling Chinese tech Twitter 'the biggest fucking cesspit.'
items.noteZh: 1,151 条推文对比：对 20 位硅谷大厂高管说话客客气气 0 脏话，转头骂中文科技圈是「史上最大粪坑」。

items.titleEn: Two Sides of the Bus: VIP vs. Regular Dev
items.titleZh: 大巴车两头：大厂高管 vs 普通程序员
items.noteEn: One side gets 0% profanity and praise; regular engineers get told they 'deserve the mass unemployment.'
items.noteZh: 坐大厂高管这边全是吹捧和零脏话；坐普通程序员这边得到的却是「活该大规模失业」。

items.titleZh: 小丑化妆四步：0 件商标强行维权
items.noteEn: Threaten a GitHub ban for 'trademark infringement,' hold zero USPTO trademarks, retroactively merge TRADEMARK.md 17 hours later, then tell people to get a better lawyer.
items.noteZh: 先拿商标侵权威胁封号，一查美国商标局 0 件注册，17 小时后偷偷补份 TRADEMARK.md，还反过来让人「换个好点的律师」。

items.noteZh: 刚立牌子宣布从不记路径和 IP，自家连夜打的 GDPR 补丁转手就把每小时 220 万条 IP 日志和路径泄露全抖了出来。

items.titleEn: Chinese Idiom #04: 指鹿为马 (Calling a Deer a Horse)
items.titleZh: 每日成语 #04：指鹿为马
items.noteEn: Pointing at zero USPTO registrations and calling it a federal trademark, then merging TRADEMARK.md 17 hours after threatening a ban.
items.noteZh: 对着 0 件美国注册商标硬喊联邦商标侵权，威胁完封号过了 17 小时才补出一份 TRADEMARK.md。

items.titleEn: Chinese Idiom #05: 叶公好龙 (Loves Dragons Until One Shows Up)
items.titleZh: 每日成语 #05：叶公好龙
items.noteEn: Puts 'Steal our code (legally)!' on the MIT homepage, then melts down and threatens a GitHub ban the moment someone actually forks it.
items.noteZh: 官网首页挂着 MIT 协议写「欢迎合法偷我们代码」，真有人来 Fork 了又瞬间破防威胁封号。

items.titleEn: Chinese Idiom #06: 掩耳盗铃 (Plugging Ears to Steal a Bell)
items.titleZh: 每日成语 #06：掩耳盗铃
items.noteEn: Silently deleting 'No telemetry' from the README and fixing critical security holes in quiet commits while keeping GitHub Security Advisories at 0.
items.noteZh: 悄悄删掉 README 里的绝不追踪承诺，高危安全洞混在普通提交里偷摸改掉，只要不发安全公告就当没发生过。

items.titleZh: T3 Code 黑历史冰山全景图
items.noteEn: Five tiers deep from the surface 'Temu3 Code' tweet down to 41.6 GB fake deletes, 2.2M/hr IP logs, 0 advisories, and the 4 AM deleted meltdown.
items.noteZh: 一张冰山图看完五层瓜：从水面上的 Temu3 威胁，一路深挖到 41.6 GB 假删除、220 万/时 IP 日志和凌晨四点删帖。

items.titleZh: 宝可梦进化链 #01：刷星大帝

items.titleZh: 宝可梦进化链 #02：三年循环（凌晨四点重置）
items.noteEn: Evolves from 2024 Indian-dev apology to 2025 FFmpeg bounty drama to 2026 Chinese Twitter meltdown, then resets at 4 AM.
items.noteZh: 从 2024 年挂印度开发者道歉，进化到 2025 年 FFmpeg 悬赏风波，再到 2026 年中文圈破防，凌晨 4 点删帖重置循环。

items.titleZh: 2024 到 2026：三年一模一样的循环
